_comment: The book's identity on Amazon, in one place. The ASIN is currently hard-coded into fourteen files, so republishing the combined edition would otherwise mean fourteen hand-edits and one silent miss pointing readers at a delisted book. tools/check-book.mjs proves every link agrees with this file; tools/set-asin.mjs rewrites them all when the ASIN changes.
title: Cleared For Take-Off
_republish_note: When the combined single edition goes live it gets a NEW ASIN and the old listings are unpublished. Run `node tools/set-asin.mjs <NEW_ASIN>` from this folder: it updates this file and every link across the site in one pass, then `npm run check` proves nothing was missed. Do not hand-edit the pages.
